subject: general
question: Abdul’s salary is Rs. 1,50,000 per month. He spends 10% of his salary on paying the school fees. He got an increment of 3% in his salary in the month of July, but the school fee was hiked by 5% the same month. What will be the net change in his saving in the month of July if the other expenditures are the same?
solution:
**Given data:**

Initial salary (S) = Rs. 1,50,000

School fees = 10% of S

Salary increment = 3%

School fees increment = 5%

**Concept:** 

Net change in saving = (Change in salary - Change in school fees)

**Calculation:**

Initial salary = Rs. 1,50,000

⇒ Initial school fees = 10% of salary = Rs. 15,000
